T1 North Shore Line: Buses replace trains between Hornsby and Milsons Point. Use metro between Chatswood and the City
Monday 11 and Tuesday 12 May Nightly from 9 20 PM to 1 30 AM, buses replace trains from Hornsby to Milsons Point.

Monday 11 and Tuesday 12 May
  • Nightly from 9.20pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains from Hornsby to Milsons Point.
  • The last train from Hornsby to the City leaves Hornsby at 21:12, arriving Wynyard at 21:55.

  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains from Milsons Point to Hornsby.
  • The last train to Hornsby leaves Wynyard at 21:52, arriving Hornsby at 22:34.
  • The last train to Gordon leaves Wynyard at 21:55, arriving Gordon at 22:23.

  • Replacement buses also stop at Crows Nest and Victoria Cross metro stations.
  • Use metro services between Chatswood, Crows Nest or Victoria Cross and the City.
  • T9 Northern Line trains run between Berowra or Hornsby and Central, platforms 1-14.
  • Some late-night buses run between T1 North Shore Line stations and Wynyard.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus routes
97T1 Chatswood, all stations to Milsons Point (including Crows Nest and Victoria Cross metro stations)
and return (late-night services extend to Wynyard)
98T1 Hornsby, all stations to Chatswood and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.

Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Some trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
Wednesday 13 and Thursday 14 May Nightly from 9 50 PM to 1 30 AM, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.

Wednesday 13 and Thursday 14 May   
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Cronulla, Waterfall and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.
  • Change at:
    • Sydenham or Central for metro services to Martin Place
    • Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    • Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction.

  • Nightly from 10.10pm to 1.30am, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
